puzzle.label: Puzzle making
puzzle.subject: a jigsaw puzzle being assembled on a light oak wooden table
puzzle.hands: a pair of relaxed adult hands with short clean nails, no rings, sleeves out of frame
puzzle.camera: locked-off overhead top-down shot, occasional slow macro push-in on the piece being placed
puzzle.lighting: soft diffused morning window light, gentle shadows, warm neutral tones
puzzle.palette: muted pastels, cream, sage green, dusty blue
puzzle.motion: slow deliberate movements, one piece at a time, each piece slides and clicks into place
puzzle.sound_cues: soft cardboard click as a piece seats, light shuffle of pieces, quiet room tone
shot_ideas: hands sort edge pieces into a neat pile
a finger slides a piece across the table and rotates it into position
macro close-up as a piece presses down and clicks into place
hands sweep loose pieces gently toward the centre
the final piece is placed and the hands rest beside the finished puzzle

squishy.label: Squishy toy
squishy.subject: a soft pastel squishy toy (slow-rising foam) on a matte surface
squishy.hands: a pair of relaxed adult hands with short clean nails, no rings, sleeves out of frame
squishy.camera: close-up macro at a slight high angle, shallow depth of field, steady tripod
squishy.lighting: soft diffused studio light, creamy bokeh background, no harsh highlights
squishy.motion: slow squeeze, hold, then release so the foam rises back very slowly
squishy.sound_cues: soft squish and gentle foam crackle, quiet room tone
shot_ideas: both thumbs press slowly into the centre of the squishy and hold
fingers release and the foam slowly rises back to shape
hands roll the squishy gently between palms
a single fingertip presses a dimple and lets it refill
macro of the foam texture as it slowly reforms
